candidate_sentence_map.S1: OODA AI reported a substantial commercial expansion in 2025, while the Group remained loss-making because of significant impairments and valuation-related financial charges.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased to SEK 32,058 thousand from SEK 1,061 thousand, with net sales rising to SEK 31,880 thousand from SEK 1,056 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The increase reflected invoicing from several major transactions and was generated entirely from consulting services, primarily in Switzerland and other international markets.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Operating loss narrowed to SEK 29,270 thousand from SEK 51,781 thousand, while EBITDA improved to SEK 2,957 thousand from a negative SEK 28,229 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: EBITDA was affected by approximately SEK 10,238 thousand in non-recurring costs related to the liquidation of older company structures; excluding these costs, adjusted EBITDA was approximately SEK 13,195 thousand, corresponding to an adjusted margin of about 32% of revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Personnel costs increased to SEK 9,210 thousand from SEK 7,432 thousand, although the Group continued to operate with a low cost base and only four average employees.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Despite the stronger core business, the Group recorded a net loss of SEK 125,799 thousand, compared with SEK 83,355 thousand in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Financial items deteriorated to a loss of SEK 95,853 thousand, mainly due to impairments and results from associated companies.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Impairments included SEK 63,243 thousand on associated-company holdings and SEK 32,227 thousand on other securities and receivables.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: As a result, earnings per share declined to negative SEK 35.29 from negative SEK 29.00.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company made important commercial and strategic progress during the year.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The Win.Rocks AG relationship reached a total contract value of approximately SEK 21 million, followed by a new agreement worth at least SEK 15 million over 24 months in December.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Agreements were also established with HMM Deutschland and Sergel Kredittjänster, while partnerships with Allgeier Inovar and TIM Solutions supported broader distribution.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: OODA AI further developed its Universal AI Platform, decentralized AI infrastructure, MVP and test network, with broader platform commercialization planned for the second quarter of 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The financial position weakened substantially because of portfolio restructuring and impairments.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Equity fell to SEK 23,859 thousand from SEK 119,371 thousand, and financial assets declined to SEK 8,387 thousand from SEK 96,036 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash flow from operating activities improved to negative SEK 16,662 thousand from negative SEK 29,680 thousand, and was positive by SEK 5,098 thousand in the second half.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: However, investing activities consumed SEK 49,413 thousand, while rights issues generated SEK 44,574 thousand, leaving cash at SEK 3,335 thousand at year-end.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The Board considers continued commercialization, cost control and access to additional capital essential to maintaining operations in 2026.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K5, K6, and K8 are PRESENT with clear evidence in the candidate summary. K4 (group structure streamlining) is MISSING - no mention of mergers of EO Capital 2/3, EPLIK companies, oodash Sweden AB, or EO Capital 1 AB into OODA AI AB. K7 (strategic shift to growth phase) is MISSING - no explicit statement about scaling platform usage, expanding distribution, or infrastructure development focus. K9 (material post-reporting-period events) is MISSING - no reference to January 5, 2026 merger completion, Q2 2026 platform launch, or March 31, 2026 cash issue. The summary captures most core financial and commercial developments but omits three HIGH-importance structural, strategic, and post-period event items.
